description: Canonical semantic mapping between research vocabulary, replay tool report keys, and validation runner fields for Phase 2 replay evidence. Read REPLAY_POLICY_NAMING_DRIFT.md for background.
naming_drift_warning: lifecycle_profit_management_replay uses independent policy letter assignments. Its policy_D is the fixed SR<60 derisk (research 'Policy B'). The literal policy_B key in that tool refers to 'reduce-50% at 2x entry price', a different strategy. All other Phase 2 tools use policy_B for fixed SR<60 derisk. The canonical registry resolves this drift so aggregate metrics track the correct policy across sessions.
guardrail: This registry is offline/research metadata only. It does not change runtime trading behavior, strategy, risk sizing, execution, or paper/live separation.

policies.semantic_meaning: Exit at the first market snapshot where seconds_remaining < 60. No probability, volatility, or convergence condition. Conservative fixed-window exit applied uniformly.
policies.validation_notes: Current best deployable replay policy on single-session evidence. Must replicate in >= 4 of 5 validation sessions before Phase 3 consideration. See MULTI_SESSION_VALIDATION_PLAN.md.

tool_mappings.naming_drift_impact: Runner extracted policy_B key, producing rank=5 ($62.25) instead of correct policy_D rank=1 ($67.67). Canonical resolution corrects this.
tool_mappings.notes: Named policy_D in this tool. The literal policy_B key maps to 'reduce-50% at 2x entry price' — a different strategy that has no equivalent in the research vocabulary.
Consistent with research alias. No resolution required.
Used as the fixed-derisk baseline for commitment score comparison. Accessed directly as report.baseline_pnl_policy_b (scalar, not nested).

policies.semantic_meaning: Hold position until market settlement. No exit before close. Full exposure to binary resolution. Serves as the baseline for uplift calculations.
policies.validation_notes: Riskier than fixed_sr60_derisk in seed session. $5.22 lower PnL and $0.82 higher max drawdown. Hold logic is rejected for the current Phase 2 evidence. See RESEARCH_VERDICTS.md V-R03.

policies.semantic_meaning: Take 50% profit when position value reaches 2x entry price. Not referenced in the main research vocabulary. Local to lifecycle_profit_management_replay.
policies.validation_notes: This is lifecycle_profit_management_replay's policy_B. It has no equivalent in the research vocabulary. Its $62.25 PnL on 2026-05-15 ranks it last (5th) among that tool's policies. Not studied further in Phase 2.
